name: Kepler-445

quotes.title: Kepler-445
quotes.card: Kepler-445 is a red dwarf star located 401 light-years away in the constellation Cygnus.
quotes.introduction: It hosts three known exoplanets, discovered by the transit method using data from the Kepler space telescope and confirmed in 2015.
